description: This file defines a benchmarking class for matrix multiplication (mm) operations, including methods for generating input sizes, running benchmarks with different tensor shapes and transpositions, and managing memory constraints.

classes.name: BenchmarkRunnerMM
classes.description: A benchmarking class for matrix multiplication (mm) operations, extending BenchmarkRunner with methods to create inputs, run benchmarks, and generate random tensor dimensions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BenchmarkRunnerMM instance with the mode 'mm'.

methods.name: create_input
methods.description: Creates random input parameters for the benchmark, including tensor dimensions and data type.

methods.name: run_benchmark
methods.description: Runs the matrix multiplication benchmark for given dimensions and data type, testing all transpose combinations.

methods.name: random_multiple_of_128
methods.description: Generates a random multiple of 128 within a specified range based on a random power of two.

methods.name: get_distr_type
methods.description: Selects a distribution type for tensor dimensions based on predefined probabilities.

methods.name: get_random_dim
methods.description: Generates a random tensor dimension based on the selected distribution type.

methods.name: get_m_k_n
methods.description: Generates tensor dimensions (m, k, n) that fit in memory and are suitable for benchmarking.
